releases.name: OW Voice Acting Mod v0.4.0 - Premix
releases.body:
All unedited audio files are included in this version, normalized and converted to mono.

Outstanding Issues:
- Museum-chorus only uses Lexi's voice. The other's are there, they just aren't all mixed together yet.
- Some of the new-computer lines don't play because they're organized wrong. That'll be fixed with the actual release.

**Changelog:** [`0.3.12...0.4.0`](https://github.com/Krevace/ow-voice-mod/compare/0.3.12...0.4.0)
releases.bodyZh:
所有未编辑的音频文件均包含在此版本中，已进行标准化并转换为单声道。

**待解决问题：**
- 博物馆合唱部分仅使用了莱克斯(莱克斯)的音轨。其他的音轨都在那里，只是尚未全部混合在一起。
- 部分新电脑相关台词无法播放，因为它们组织方式不正确。这将在正式发布时修复。

**更新日志：** [⟦0⟧](https://github.com/Krevace/ow-voice-mod/compare/0.3.12...0.4.0)
